name: Ygalitt
source:
Profession: Owns the town's repair shop
Birthplace: The Origin of Civilization, Oriens
Race: Automata
Height: A bit short
Breast size: Big

In Oriens, the birthplace of civilization, there is a huge pyramid that cannot be built even with modern technology. The door to the center was protected by a mysterious force that kept thieves at bay. 

One day, the unopened door that seemed to be closed forever opened. What came out of it was an automata (android) made with ultra-ancient technology. 

Huh? Can automata give birth to human children?... Why dont you think they can give birth?

"I will have your child. That has been decided for 760,000 years....probably."
